summary: STEP 6 regression in preview (nothing published). Backend: the 9 requested pytest files all pass (43/43: access_rules, eye_notes_access, oftalmologia, passo5_clinics, service_rename, passo4_live, cardio_lab_placement, mantai_faithfulness, gyn_minor_guardian). Migrations API: GET /api/admin/migrations returns all 3 flags true with the preview counts. apply with backup_done:false returns 400 'Confermi di aver scaricato il backup...', {} returns 422, a doctor gets 403, no auth gets 401. Admin UI 'Aggiornamento dati' shows 3 x 'fatto', the preview box and migrations-all-done, with no apply button. Service rename (oculista UI): override 123€/45' on Prima visita survives renaming to 'TEST_Prima visita rinominata' and saving. Renamed back, and GET /settings/schedule matches the pre-test snapshot exactly. Italian date/time inputs in an en-US browser: PatientDialog new patient typing 01022015 -> 01/02/2015, saved as 2015-02-01. Existing patient Alice Conti shows 18/10/2025. 31/02/2026 gets aria-invalid=true and is not emitted. Typing works and invalid dates are flagged on all of these: portal RequestDialog (past date 01/01/2020 flagged, cleared on blur), PortalRequests confirm (date 13/01/2027, time 25:61 flagged, 15:30 accepted; confirming created an appointment listed as 'Mer 13 Gen | 15:30'), ClinicCard schedule-start-0/end-0 (24h, 08:30 typed and reverted), AvailabilitySection absence-from/to (to<from flagged; TEST absence added, shown as '20 dicembre 2027 → 22 dicembre 2027', then deleted), InvoiceDialog invoice-date (future 01/01/2030 flagged by max=today), vaccine-date-input (31/04 flagged), measure-date, ConsultationOverlay consult-new-patient-birth, NewThreadDialog 'Serve entro il', and gyn module-field-data_ultima_mestruazione. In that last one MantAI filled 2026-10-12 from the pasted transcript, the field showed 12/10/2026, was edited to 13/10/2026, saved, and the API confirmed it. Calendar: Italian, Monday first (lun..dom), and picking a day works, but at first it opened BEHIND every dialog (fixed, see below). Other regression: gyn free visit via the overlay with a pasted transcript -> async MantAI note with the ginecologia module -> PDF downloaded. Oculista Marco Demo: sign dialog blocks with 'Cristallino' (unassigned eye note); cancelled without signing. Global search works. Portal genitore sections load. Portal logout works. InvoiceDialog method reset on studio change (iter77 bug) is FIXED.

minor.issue: backend/.env CORS_ORIGINS="*" together with allow_credentials=True. The response has access-control-allow-origin: * plus allow-credentials: true. Set explicit origins for production.
Returns visits_to_module (57 in preview), but apply() never migrates visits and the panel doesn't show the number. Either drop it, or show it with an explanation (legacy visits keep working).

test_scheduling.py, test_cancel_visit.py and test_health_passport.py use hardcoded IDs/fields from an older DB (AURORA_PID 6ad29ce5..., passport_share_consent): 23 fail with 404/KeyError. test_signed_docs.py::test_cycle assumes medico has no signature. Worse, test_cash_invoicing.py and test_signed_docs.py write real data with no cleanup: invoice numbers 9-14/2026 and 3-4/2025 for medico; Aurora's privacy consent revoked and re-signed. I ran them once and then restored everything (see seed_data_creation). Fix or delete these tests before they are reused.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: the PopoverContent used z-50, but every DialogContent uses z-[60] (PatientDialog, InvoiceDialog, ScheduleDialog...). The calendar rendered under the dialog, the dialog swallowed the clicks, and no day could be picked. Changed to className='z-[75] w-auto p-0'. Retested OK in PatientDialog, portal RequestDialog, InvoiceDialog, passport tabs, ConsultationOverlay and NewThreadDialog.

The caption is cluttered and partly English: 'febbraio 2015' label + 'Month:' + select + duplicated 'febbraio ⌄' + 'Year:' + select + duplicated '2015 ⌄'. Cause: components/ui/calendar.jsx defines no classNames for react-day-picker v8 vhidden, caption_dropdowns, dropdown, dropdown_month or dropdown_year, and rdp style.css is not imported. Add vhidden:'sr-only', caption_dropdowns:'flex gap-2', dropdown:'absolute inset-0 opacity-0 cursor-pointer', dropdown_month/dropdown_year:'relative inline-flex items-center', and hide caption_label when the dropdowns are used.

Dead code: nothing imports Agenda.jsx, the only user of AppointmentDialog. appointment-date-input/time-input can't be reached in the UI. Appointments are only created through portal requests (PortalRequests confirm, tested OK). Remove it or wire it in.

issues: Partially edited text (e.g. deleting one digit -> '10/05/198') stays on screen after blur, while the saved value is still the old date. onBlur only resets when length==10. Also reset (or flag) when 0<length<10.

Absence 'Dal': once, after clearing the field and typing 20/12/2027, 'Al' did not move forward (stayed 06/11/2026). With select-all + type it worked. Low priority, please double-check the from/to sync.
The wide date input pushes 'Rifiuta' onto a second line in the request card at 1920px.
min uses new Date().toISOString() (a UTC date). Use the local date (toLocaleDateString('sv-SE')) like the calendar does.

action_items: Keep the z-[75] fix on the DateInput PopoverContent in it-date.jsx (a z above dialogs, below idle-warning z-[80]).
Fix the calendar dropdown caption styling in components/ui/calendar.jsx (hidden 'Month:/Year:' labels, duplicated month/year labels).
Remove or wire up the dead Agenda.jsx/AppointmentDialog.
DateInput: on blur, reset incomplete text to the current value.

Fix or remove the stale tests test_scheduling, test_cancel_visit, test_health_passport and test_signed_docs, and make test_cash_invoicing/test_signed_docs clean up after themselves (invoice counters, consent chain).
Production: set CORS_ORIGINS to explicit origins.
critical_code_review_comments: migrations.apply runs the 3 steps one after another with no transaction. If access_rules_v2 fails halfway, the flag is not written and a re-run repeats the conversion; the steps are idempotent, so this is acceptable.
migrations.preview loads all portal users with to_list(10000) and runs one find_one per child (N+1). Fine at the current scale.
MigrationsPanel testids are migration-flag-* (singular), not migrations-flag-* as in the brief.
There is leftover non-TEST data in the oculista account: the visit 'Paziente Occhi Claude' (6aed2ac6ff5988186f49907d), probably from an earlier agent. Not touched.
